newsitem.title: USA: Garment Graphics to liquidate assets.
newsitem.headline: Garment Graphics to liquidate assets.

text.p: Garment Graphics Inc on Friday said it planned to liquidate its assets after receiving a notice of default from its principal lender, Heller Financial Inc.
The company said in a statement it was forced to lay off the majority of its employees and thought it would be unable to cover its other obligations after liquidation.
The statement did not specify how many people were laid off, and company officials could not be reached for immediate comment.
It said it had been unable to "generate sufficient cash flow to fund" its operation and had failed to sell the business.
In October, the company reported a net loss of $0.21 a share for its fiscal second quarter ended September 30 against a net loss of $0.16 in the year-earlier quarter.
Garment Graphics, based in Minneapolis, is a designer, manufacturer and marketer of high quality embellished sportswear.
